title: Interaction language and thematic grid for cost widgets and rollout tiles
creator: Leah Kim
description: Purpose: Define a consistent interaction language and a thematic grid for cost widgets (mini spend cards, forecast sparkline, unit-cost breakdown) and rollout tiles so engineers and PMs can implement a single, reusable set of components and token mappings. This ticket covers: 1) a density-aware grid that supports compact/regular/expanded layouts, 2) a state & interaction grammar (idle, loading, error, warning, degraded, active rollout), 3) accessible patterns for focus & keyboard navigation, and 4) Figma library updates and a handoff package with token mapping to runtime names. The goal is to reduce UI variance across cost and rollout surfaces, improve perceived performance via consistent skeletons/loading behaviors, and make cost cards easier to assemble in dashboards and treatment rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Figma library contains tokenized components: cost-card, forecast-chip, rollout-tile with 3 density variants and documented token mappings
Interaction grammar doc (one-page) that lists events, animations, and fallback behaviors for network degradation is reviewed and approved by Eng and PM
Accessibility checklist met: keyboard order, focus ring contrast, screen reader labels for dynamic state changes (announcements for rollout state changes)
Handoff ZIP includes code-ready specs: padding/spacing tokens, color tokens with runtime names, CSS vars and token table, and example React props API for density + state
Design sign-off from Marco Ruiz (PM) and Owen Brooks (Frontend Eng) recorded in comments
